text_block_list.text:
It seems that Хиши Амадзон will be
running in the
Japan Cup, while
Матиканэтангейзер will be
entering the
autumn Tenno Sho taking place just

before it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Compared to the impressive competition
Narita
Brian has faced in the past,
people seem less
worried. However,
Нарита Брайан doesn't let her
guard down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ admires how hard Brian is
training.
Yet, Нарита Брайан feels
uncomfortable with how
her older sister
speaks so distantly, as if she is just
a
spectator.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
